answer: Hop-decayed trust resists sybils: endorsement weight flows from a trusted seed, shrinking geometrically each attestation hop and cut to zero past a fixed radius. Honest agents stand a short walk from the seed through real vouches; a sybil region, reachable only across the few attack edges its operator could forge, sits stranded on a distant knoll, its trust decaying hop by hop to near nothing. Adding clones — a whole island of fakes — never shortens any one's distance to the seed, so they inherit the same vanished weight, inert as quartz. Precondition: the seed is honest, attack edges costly.
